def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # The rule is shift-merge: ((last << 1) & 0xF) | (second & 1)
    # where 'last' is the last element of state and 'second' is the second-to-last
    # This appends the computed value to the state
    last = state[-1]
    second = state[-2]
    new_value = ((last << 1) & 0xF) | (second & 1)
    return state + [new_value]
